team.section.name: Team
team.title: Team
team.desc: Work together with colleagues through your own relay: see who is online and follow the runs they share, read-only.
team.security: Everything the relay carries is encrypted end to end with a key only the members hold. The relay sees who is online and how much data moves, nothing else. Removing a member starts a new key that the removed person never gets.
team.name.label: Your name in the team
team.name.ph: Your name, as colleagues see it
team.create.title: Create a team
team.create.body: You become the admin. The team lives on the relay set up in Settings > Remote (or the local development relay).
team.join.title: Join a team
team.join.body: Paste the invite code an admin gave you. Then you both compare six digits before anything is shared.
team.joining.title: Joining the team
team.joining.admin: Waiting for the admin to answer...
team.joining.welcome: Codes confirmed. Waiting for the admin to let you in...
team.joining.compare: Check that the admin sees the same six digits. If they differ, stop: somebody may be in the middle.
team.invite.title: Invite someone
team.invite.body: Give this code to one person, or let them scan the QR code. It works once and only for a few minutes.
team.invite.once: Send it over a channel you trust. Whoever uses it first gets to ask for access, and you still approve them.
team.invite.tooLong: The code is too long for a QR code. Copy it instead.
team.request.title: {name} wants to join
team.request.compare: Check that {name} sees the same six digits. Only then let them in.
team.revoke.title: Remove {name}?
team.revoke.body: They lose access at once and a new key starts for everybody else. What they already saw stays with them.
team.leave.title: Leave the team?
team.leave.body: This computer forgets the team and its keys. An admin can invite you again.
team.leave.bodyAdmin: You are the only member. This computer forgets the team and its keys. An admin cannot leave while other members remain.
team.removed.title: The relay says you were removed
team.removed.body: Nothing has been deleted on this computer. If an admin removed you, forget the team here. If you did not expect this, check with the admin first.
team.auditError: The audit log could not be opened, so nothing is being recorded: {reason}
team.tab.title: Team
team.tab.noTeam: You are not in a team
team.tab.noTeamDesc: Create a team or join one in Settings to see the runs your colleagues share.
team.tab.members: Team members and their shared runs
team.tab.alone: You are the only member so far. Invite colleagues in Settings > Team.
team.tab.readOnly: Read-only: you can watch, but you cannot answer a permission card, send a message or start a run on another machine.
team.tab.pickDesc: Choose a run on the left to follow it live.
team.tab.noRuns: Nobody shares a run right now. A run is shared when its project is switched on in Settings > Team.
team.run.perm.waiting: Waiting for the owner to decide
team.share.title: Shared projects
team.share.body: Switch a project on to let team members watch its runs live, including tool calls and file diffs. Secrets are masked first, secret files (.env, keys) and the agent's thinking never leave this computer. A project is recognised by its git remote origin, so a folder without one cannot be shared. You can switch off single runs too.
team.share.noOrigin: No git origin, cannot be shared
team.share.newRun: Share this run with the team
team.share.newRunOn: Visible to the team while its project is shared.
team.share.runTip: Switch off to withdraw this run from the team at once. Switching on again shares what happens from then on.
team.note.bannerAsk: Accept or reject it in the run.
team.note.bannerAuto: Passed on to the agent (trusted member).
team.note.hint: Accepting gives it to the agent with its next tool call, marked as your teammate's. Rejecting tells the sender.
team.note.composerHint: {name} decides whether the agent gets it. A note is all you can send: you cannot answer permission cards, answer questions or start anything on their computer.
team.note.unavailable: Notes can be sent only while the run is working, its owner is online and it is a Claude run.
team.note.reason.rate: Too many notes, wait a minute
team.note.reason.unsupported: This agent does not take notes
team.note.autoTip: Notes from this member go to your agents without asking. Everything else stays off limits.
team.note.autoAria: Pass on notes from {name} without asking
team.ws.title: Changes in {project}
team.ws.aheadBehind: Commits ahead of and behind the upstream branch
team.ws.emptyDesc: Press Refresh to ask for the current changes. It is only a snapshot, not a live view.
team.ws.truncated: The snapshot is cut at 512 KB; some files or lines are missing.
team.ws.skipped.secret: The content of this file is never shared (it looks like a secret).
team.ws.skipped.unreadable: The diff could not be read.
team.ws.skipped.limit: Left out to keep the snapshot small.
team.ws.problem.off: This project's workspace is not open to the team. Its owner can switch it on in Settings > Team.
team.ws.problem.rate: Asked too soon. A snapshot can be requested once every 30 seconds.
team.ws.problem.noProject: That project is not open on their computer.
team.ws.problem.damaged: The snapshot arrived damaged and was dropped. Try again.
team.ws.problem.unavailable: Their computer could not read the changes.
team.ws.problem.noAnswer: No answer. They may be offline.
team.ws.settingBody: Workspace lets teammates ask for a read-only snapshot of this project's changes (branch, changed files and their diffs, at most 512 KB, secrets masked, secret files and binaries left out). Off by default.
team.ws.toggle: Let the team see the changes of {name}
team.mem.title: Shared Claude memory
team.mem.offDesc: Switch on "Share Claude memory" for a project in Settings > Team. Its memory notes and CLAUDE.md are then kept equal on every teammate's computer.
team.mem.offline: Not connected to the team's relay. Changes are kept and shared when the connection is back.
team.mem.rejected: {n} shared file(s) failed the signature or path checks and were ignored.
team.mem.skipped: {n} local file(s) were left alone (a symlink, over 240 KB, or past 500 files).
team.mem.noneOpen: None of the switched-on projects is open in this workspace.
team.mem.conflictBody: You and {name} both changed this file. {name}'s text is the file now; yours is saved next to it as {file}.
team.mem.settingBody: Shared memory (beta) keeps a project's Claude memory notes equal on every teammate's computer, encrypted for the team. Only .md files up to 240 KB are shared; a conflict is never merged for you. Off by default.
team.mem.claudeMdWarn: CLAUDE.md has its own switch. It changes what every teammate's agent reads first, so a teammate's change to it is never written on its own: you see the difference and choose Apply or Ignore.
team.mem.claudeMdToggle: Also share CLAUDE.md of {name} (changes what teammates' agents read)
team.mem.pendingBody: {name} changed CLAUDE.md. It is not written until you apply it.
team.mem.pendingDeleted: {name} deleted CLAUDE.md. It stays until you apply this.
team.mem.pendingBannerBody: Open Shared memory to view the difference and apply or ignore it.
team.err.relayOld: Your relay does not support teams yet. Update it in Settings > Remote → Update relay.
team.err.relayHttp: The relay answered with an unexpected error (HTTP {status}). Try again in a moment.
team.err.timeout: The relay did not answer in time. Check your connection and try again.
team.err.unreachable: The relay could not be reached. Check the relay address in Settings > Remote and your connection.
